### Findings (1)

**general** (1)
- `backlog/x7qu5y1-the-drain-now-calls-review-set-label-with-a-repo-it-may-not-.md:12` — The card's entire "why this is a trap and not a live bug" argument rests on a claim that is false against current main: it says `restamp` was never added to the `to === 'accepted' || to === 'clear-human'` gate that computes `reviewedDiff`, so "no fingerprint is computed" — but `restamp` IS already in that gate (and in the marker-stamping `stampsAcceptance` gate that renders `reviewed-diff`/`reviewed-contribution` into the comment). — Verified directly against scripts/review-set-label.mjs at current HEAD (52a2596f): line 586 reads `if (to === 'accepted' || to === 'clear-human' || to === 'restamp')` around the `computeNetDiffText` call, and line 836/842-849 (`buildVerdictComment`) includes `restamp` in `stampsAcceptance` and renders `buildReviewedDiffMarker`/`buildReviewedContributionMarker` for it. Both were added in the SAME commit that introduced the `restamp` target (507f6640, '#x5e2ldj drain re-stamp'), which landed as part of #1482 — i.e. before this backlog PR was authored. So a `restamp` call today already attempts to fingerprint whatever tree `process.cwd()` points to (no cwd is threaded through `restampAcceptance`'s `spawnSync`, and the drain never `chdir`s per its own header comment), and — per `buildVerdictComment` — stamps that fingerprint into `reviewed-diff`/`reviewed-contribution` markers when the git read happens not to throw (e.g. a same-named lane branch existing locally, which sibling code elsewhere in merge-ai-prs.mjs explicitly warns is a real collision risk across the constellation's shared `lane/<NNN>-<slug>` naming). This is the opposite of "inert today": a future reader triaging this card as a dormant, low-urgency "someday" risk (per its own Done-when item 1, which says a defending test "would pass vacuously today" and must be written against a restamp that "DOES compute a fingerprint" as if that's a future state) would deprioritize investigating what may already be a live wrong-tree-fingerprinting exposure. This diff itself makes no code changes, so there is no line to mutate/redden in it; the discrepancy was confirmed by reading the actual current source rather than by a test. _[impact if unfixed: degraded]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ No cheap deterministic gate exists for this class (verifying a backlog card's quoted code-behavior claims against the named file's current content at PR time); the realistic mitigation is a habit/checklist item — re-run the grep/read that grounds an 'X is not yet wired in' claim immediately before opening the PR, not carry forward an earlier investigation's snapshot. Not currently captured as an existing check:standards rule or hook.
